source_snapshot.procedure: Open Settings > User Management, then attempt five WebUI creates: valid name/invalid password; invalid name/valid password; invalid name/invalid password; existing name/valid password; valid name/valid password.
source_snapshot.criteria: Each branch behaves according to specification; invalid/duplicate inputs show an error and create no user, while the valid case appears in the user list.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL recognizes an operator-driven security write but collapses add/delete/modify, uses insecure partial API readback and does not exercise all five inputs, define valid/invalid policy, protect passwords, prove negative non-creation, constrain role/slot or clean up.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION with CRITICAL risk correctly requires an approved five-row policy matrix, unique disposable identities, one submission per row, redacted WebUI errors/audit, no-create proof for four negative rows, persisted role/state and bounded login for the valid row, recovery and cleanup.

old_problem: The source intentionally combines four rejection branches and one real account creation, but it does not supply the firmware's username/password/duplicate/role/slot policy or safe disposable values. Generic UI/API success cannot prove server-side non-creation for rejected inputs, correct role and usable login for the accepted account, protected credential handling or exact cleanup. Those values can be parameterized without reducing any branch.
disposition_reason: Preserve all five source branches as independent rows tied to the authoritative target policy. Submit each once through the actual WebUI, capture the exact visual validation, prove no account/slot/audit creation for each negative row, and separately prove the valid disposable account's persisted least-privilege role, login and bounded authorization before approved cleanup. Missing test values are runtime configuration, not a remaining engineering decision.
decision_basis: XLSX row 936, same-row DeepSeek, exact GPT V2, tests JSON, selection manifest, adjacent View/Delete-User rows and preserved V3.1 record were directly reviewed; row 937 and its manifest identity were independently verified.
ED-20/ED-23 require actual WebUI and visual evidence; Redfish inventory/audit may prove persistent state but cannot replace the prescribed form validation and displayed error behavior.
DMTF Redfish ManagerAccount provides structured identity, role and enabled-state corroboration for the positive and negative postconditions, subject to the target schema.
ED-33 through ED-38 allow Project-bound policy values while preserving every source branch, one approved write at a time, deterministic recovery and engineer-owned DUT verdict.

test_case.test_name: Execute all five WebUI account-create validation branches with disposable least-privilege cleanup
test_case.purpose: Verify independently that the BMC WebUI rejects valid-name/invalid-password, invalid-name/valid-password, both-invalid and duplicate-name submissions without creating any account or consuming a slot, then accepts one valid unique disposable account with the approved least-privilege role, persists and authenticates it correctly, preserves recovery accounts and returns exactly to baseline after cleanup.
required_package: Target BMC/firmware/WebUI build and authoritative username character/length/reserved-name, password complexity/length/history, duplicate/case-folding, role, slot, rate-limit and lockout policy
Five-row matrix with unambiguous values and expected visual/server result for each exact source branch

Unique disposable non-production valid username/password, separate invalid examples that fail exactly one intended rule where applicable, and a non-protected existing disposable name for duplicate testing
Approved least-privilege role and bounded allowed/denied action matrix for the successful account
Complete redacted pre-state of accounts/slots/roles/sessions/audit plus protected recovery-account list
Protected WebUI credential/secret injection and screenshot redaction, independent local-admin/console recovery, per-submission approval and exact cleanup plan
test_case.test_command: CRITICAL ACCOUNT/SECURITY WRITE; DO NOT EXECUTE WITHOUT THE APPROVED MATRIX AND POINT-OF-ACTION AUTHORIZATION. Preserve security logs, verify target/recovery and capture complete redacted account/slot/session baseline. A human/operator uses the actual Settings > User Management form and submits exactly once in this order, resetting the form between rows: (1) valid name + invalid password, (2) invalid name + valid password, (3) invalid name + invalid password, (4) existing non-protected disposable name + valid password, (5) unique valid name + valid password and approved least-privilege role. For every row, capture the redacted fields, visual error/success and audit event, then collect complete trusted account inventory and slot count. Rows 1-4 must create no visible or hidden/partial account and consume no slot. Row 5 must persist one exact account; verify ID, role, enabled state, one bounded login and allowed/denied permissions from an independent session. Delete/disable only that disposable account under cleanup approval, verify logout/session policy and exact final baseline. Do not expose passwords, touch protected accounts, clear logs or retry automatically.
test_case.expected_result: Each of the four negative/duplicate rows produces the target-policy error at the correct WebUI validation layer, creates no ManagerAccount or hidden/partial identity, consumes no slot and leaves account/session state unchanged. The valid row creates exactly one unique disposable account with the approved least-privilege role/enabled state; its credentials authenticate once and its allowed/denied permissions match policy without affecting recovery access. Cleanup removes/disables only that account as approved, closes its test session and restores the full baseline.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: Each row has an independent verdict. A negative row passes only with the expected visible error plus complete inventory/slot/audit proof of non-creation. The positive row passes only with exact persisted identity/role/state, successful bounded login, correct allowed/denied behavior, recovery continuity and cleanup/final equality. UI toast, HTTP status or list appearance alone cannot pass. Unexpected creation, wrong/missing error, partial account, slot leak, privilege escalation, lockout/rate-limit spillover, secret exposure, protected-account impact or cleanup failure is FAIL and stops all later rows. Missing policy/values/recovery/approval is NOT READY.
safety_gate: Use only disposable non-production identities and secrets; never reuse production passwords, duplicate a protected account name or grant administrator role without a separate source-required policy decision.
Keep passwords/tokens out of screenshots, DOM captures, browser history, logs, API output and review records; record only redacted rule satisfaction.
Submit each matrix row once, prove no hidden account/slot after every negative case and stop on ambiguity, lockout/rate limiting or unexpected server state.
Maintain an independently tested local-admin/console recovery account and complete baseline; never delete/modify/disable existing users to make room.
Actual WebUI form/error evidence is mandatory; API corroboration cannot substitute. Do not clear audit logs or automatically retry.
expected_evidence: Approved target policy and five-row matrix, disposable identity/least role, protected recovery list and complete redacted baseline
Per-row human WebUI screenshots/DOM showing redacted inputs and exact error/success with timestamps and audit correlation
Complete post-row account/slot inventories proving rows 1-4 created nothing and changed no slot/state
Row-5 account ID/role/enabled readback, bounded login and allowed/denied permission evidence plus recovery continuity
Exact disposable cleanup/session handling, final baseline equality, preserved logs/no secret exposure and five independent verdicts
test_case.recovery: If any negative row creates a partial account, the valid account receives wrong privilege, recovery changes or cleanup fails, stop all remaining submissions without retry. Use the independent local-admin/console path to disable/remove only verified disposable artifacts under approval, close test sessions, restore the saved account/role baseline, preserve audit evidence and rotate all disposable secrets. Do not delete or alter protected accounts.

source_conflict.reason: Items, Procedure and Criteria consistently define four rejection branches and one successful WebUI create. Exact valid/invalid values, role and policy are parameterized readiness inputs.

blocked.reason: All five behaviors, acceptance, safety and cleanup are defined. Target policy and disposable inputs can be supplied before execution.
